newsitem.title: UK: London stocks end lower, Greenspan jitters weigh.
newsitem.headline: London stocks end lower, Greenspan jitters weigh.

text.p: UK shares finished marginally lower on Monday, weighed down by a batch of ex-dividend issues as well as uncertainty over forthcoming words of wisdom on financial markets from Fed chairman Alan Greenspan.

Fears that the U.S. central bank chief could hint at higher interest rates or attempt to pour cold water on a hot stock market when he testifies before the U.S. Congress on Wednesday and Thursday, outweighed a firmer tone on Wall Street.
"The real worry is whether or not he'll try to dampen enthusiasm for stocks," one trader said. The FTSE 100 index leading shares ended 5.7 points lower at 4,331.1.
